name: modal
accessibility: Native <dialog> (modal): the page behind is inert, focus moves in and stays in, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger. `title` names it and `description` describes it.
example:
<Modal open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} title="Delete project?" description="This cannot be undone.">
  <ModalFooter>
    <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button variant="accent" onClick={remove}>Delete</Button>
  </ModalFooter>
</Modal>
